knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The finish check confirms the agreed cleaning standard. It does not confirm safety, function or compliance.
A moisture line is rechecked and recorded. If it remains, it is photographed and referred. No watertight claim is made.
The person who applied the isolation removes it, after checking the machine is clear, and the removal is recorded.
The statement says what was cleaned, that gas and internal parts were excluded and referred, and it makes no compliance or readiness claim.
Excluded parts and referrals in the record show what was and was not done, and who was told.

practicalCriteria: Checks surfaces, seams, labels and seals by eye and by hand against the agreed standard
Restores all trays, racks, bins, covers and guards to their correct positions
Writes a handover statement with no safety, function or compliance claim
Records excluded parts and referrals in the job record before leaving the site
passRule: Knowledge checks: at least 4 of 5 correct (80%). Practical sign-off is separate: an assessor observes the practical criteria and records the result. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not grant any licence or authority.
evidenceRequired: Before and after photographs, with the data plate where required
Products used with dilution and surface, and exclusions with reasons
Handover statement, site contact name and time of handover
stopWorkCriteria: Handover statement that claims the appliance is safe, working or compliant
A guard, cover or tray left off
A moisture line or seal fault not recorded or referred
